run_evaluation_episode: run the stretch exploration evaluation episode with a discrete agent and optional dry run mode
run_evaluation_with_dry_run: run the evaluation episode in dry run mode to print actions without executing them on the robot
run_evaluation_with_sampling_agent: run the evaluation episode with a sampling agent type instead of the default discrete agent
review_exploration_agent_loop: review the main evaluation loop that gets observations, acts, and applies actions until the episode ends
review_episode_metrics: review the episode metrics returned by the stretch exploration environment after evaluation completes
